experience.title: Founder & Software Engineer
experience.description: Software studio building Rainy Day, a deterministic-first financial intelligence platform for Caribbean consumers using bank statements as the primary data source.
experience.longDescription:
BuiltByGervonte LLC is the creative software studio behind Ignition Labs, focused on practical fintech products for emerging Caribbean markets.

Rainy Day helps users understand years of spending with dramatically less manual review by combining deterministic financial processing, constrained AI suggestions, reviewable outputs, and privacy-safe observability.
achievements: Built statement ingestion for 4 institutions, including CIBC Caribbean, Scotiabank Caribbean, Bank of The Bahamas, and Teachers & Salaried Workers Co-operative Credit Union, normalizing to a canonical transaction model.
Designed a hybrid workflow that applies deterministic financial rules first, then constrained structured AI only for unresolved cases, keeping financial outputs reviewable.

Benchmarked approximately 1,400 real transactions across four years of statements, raising deterministic suggestion coverage from approximately 70% to 80% and classified coverage to approximately 94% on unresolved cases.
Reduced estimated manual review workload by approximately 50% through deterministic categorization, constrained AI recovery, and grouped review workflows.
Used Langfuse trace-level analysis to catch a recurring-transaction grouping defect before production, cut review time, and raise categorization accuracy through retraced runs.

Used PostHog funnel analytics to identify a profile-selection gate causing 44% drop-off before product entry; redesigned onboarding, raising first-time product entry to 97% and reaching 30% full app tour completion.
Built Supabase/Postgres persistence with Row Level Security, transactional upload RPCs, statement hashing, parser validation, and overlap-safe deduplication.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
experience.description: Credit infrastructure and analytics platform that helps businesses use alternative financial data for underwriting, income verification, and credit access.
experience.longDescription:
Nova Credit helps financial institutions, lenders, property managers, and other businesses make credit decisions using consumer-permissioned alternative financial data.

Its current platform includes Credit Passport® for international credit data, Cash Atlas™ for cash flow underwriting, Income Navigator for income verification, and Eligibility Compass.

I worked on Credit Passport®, the product that translates foreign credit histories into US-equivalent scores for newcomers whose financial records are not visible to traditional domestic credit systems.
achievements: Engineered Public API features that expanded Credit Passport® for international partners, tying cross-border credit access to HSBC’s global partnership and $10M investment.
Owned Public API integration work for the Philippines, Kenya, and Dominican Republic within a 13-country rollout, improving partner integration consistency.
Built secure REST API workflows using TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL to expose real-time international credit data through developer endpoints.
Implemented bureau-specific retry logic across supported markets, defining expected behavior and validating flows through integration testing.
Created and maintained customer-facing API documentation from scratch, defining endpoints and request/response contracts for international partners.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer Intern
experience.location: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area, Utah
experience.description: B2B software platform helping teams build custom internal apps and automate workflows with low-code tools.
experience.longDescription:
Completed a full-stack software engineering internship at Quickbase, a software company founded in 1999 as OneBase and spun off from Intuit in March 2016.

Quickbase provides an enterprise low-code platform for building secure cloud applications, workflow automation, and operational efficiency. 

During the internship, I contributed to production features as part of a platform migration effort involving legacy C++ systems and React-based product surfaces.
achievements: Built early engineering fundamentals through production tasks connected to the platform’s transition from legacy C++ systems toward React-based interfaces.
Supported other interns through pair programming, debugging, and helping move user stories forward more quickly.

researchProjects.title: AI-Assisted User Story Generation
researchProjects.description: Research project exploring how AI can improve Agile development workflows
achievements: Co-authored IEEE publication evaluating 20+ large language models for Agile user-story generation and story-point estimation across a 40,014-story dataset.
Compared model performance across accuracy, cost efficiency, latency, and stability to produce deployment recommendations for production environments.
Produced implementation guidance balancing throughput, inference cost, and reasoning quality for different engineering use cases.

researchProjects.title: Enhancing Fake News Detection with Explainability
researchProjects.description: Machine learning research focused on making AI decisions more transparent and trustworthy
achievements: Added LIME-based explainability to a high-accuracy classification model for fake news detection, improving transparency for non-technical stakeholders.
Built interactive HTML visualizations of model decisions to simulate user-facing explainability tools.
Analyzed the system's robustness and generalizability to mimic production-ready ML pipelines.
